description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate EmployeeEducation entities, such as associating employees and education records, and formatting start/end dates. It uses traits for ORM helpers and date handling, indicating it is part of a domain logic layer within a human resource management system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeEducation entity, providing methods to associate employees and education records and retrieve formatted start/end dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeEducation entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the given employee number.

methods.name: setEducationByEducationId
methods.description: Associates an Education entity with the given education ID.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the education, or null if not set.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the education, or null if not set.
